verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI assistant built into the Carta product itself. What Carta documents is pre-built plugins and an official MCP server that let an external assistant (Claude) query cap tables and fund data in natural language and generate tear sheets, budgets, financial statements and PDFs. That is real task delegation, but it happens outside the product. Missing for 10: a native in-product AI assistant, documentation of delegating tasks inside the Carta UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
